subject: Behavioral Economics
title: The Gruen Transfer
description: A quick, practical guide to The Gruen Transfer.

hook.text: You walk into a shopping mall for one item. Two hours later you leave with five bags.

buildup.text: The Gruen transfer is the moment a shopper's purposeful visit turns into wandering browsing. Store design triggers it.

discovery.text: IKEA perfected this with one-way paths. You must walk through every department.

twist.text: Victor Gruen, who designed the first mall, later regretted his creation. He intended community spaces, not consumption.

climax.text: Write a shopping list before entering any store. A clear purpose resists the Gruen transfer.

punchline.text: The store is designed so you forget why you came.

quiz.question: What is the Gruen transfer?
options: Moving products between stores for inventory management
The moment a shopper's purposeful visit becomes aimless browsing
A payment processing method used in retail
